record.name: Twilio
record.one_liner: A cloud communications platform that enables developers to programmatically send and receive SMS, voice, and other communication channels.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up and get free access to tools and a developer account.
record.api_note: The Twilio REST API allows you to query metadata about your account, phone numbers, calls, text messages, and recordings.

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication.
Start with free access to tools, then $0.0001 per request or invocation.
The Twilio REST API allows you to query metadata about your account, phone numbers, calls, text messages, and recordings.
Our MCP server, hosted at mcp.twilio.com/docs, exposes two tools
